subject: Archaeology
title: Nebuchadnezzar's Babylon
description: A quick, practical guide to Nebuchadnezzar's Babylon.

hook.text: Nebuchadnezzar II made Babylon the most magnificent city on earth — and destroyed Jerusalem's temple to do it.

buildup.text: He rebuilt Babylon with massive walls, the Ishtar Gate, a towering ziggurat, and grand processional streets.

discovery.text: He conquered Jerusalem in 586 BCE and deported thousands of Jews to Babylon — the Babylonian Exile shaped Judaism.

twist.text: Babylon in the Bible is a symbol of evil. But for Babylonians, Nebuchadnezzar was a hero who built a golden age.

climax.text: Alexander the Great intended to make Babylon his capital. He died there in 323 BCE before he could rebuild it.

punchline.text: One king made it a wonder. Another tried to revive it.

quiz.question: What major religious event did Nebuchadnezzar cause?
options: He converted the Babylonian Empire to monotheism
He destroyed Jerusalem's temple and deported Jews — the Babylonian Exile
He ordered the writing of the first version of the Torah
